anomalies.description: A large explosion occurs in the distance, producing a rising plume of dark smoke and white debris; at ~11.0s a bright fireball appears above the smoke column.

A bright flash and rapidly expanding fireball appear above the debris field, indicating a secondary explosion or detonation of ordnance/fuel.; Sustained plume of dark smoke and white vapor rising from the impact site, consistent with post-detonation combustion and residual effects of a large explosion.

A large explosion occurs on the ground, producing a rising column of dark smoke and a wide expanding cloud of white/grey debris and dust; the blast appears sustained over several seconds with multiple visible pressure fronts and ejection of material.

A large explosion occurs on the ground, producing a massive plume of white and dark smoke/ debris rising vertically; the initial blast is visible across frames f0–f4.; A secondary, smaller explosion or fragmentation event occurs mid-air above the primary blast site, evidenced by a distinct dark object (likely debris) being ejected upward and then falling, coinciding with a new plume of smoke rising from the ground at f13–f15.

A secondary, sustained explosive event or fragmentation: a dark object (likely a vehicle component or projectile) is violently ejected upward from the blast site and ascends through the smoke column, visible from f5 to f15.

A large ground explosion produces a rising column of dark smoke and white debris, followed by a secondary fireball and fragmentation at ~24.0s; a small dark object (likely projectile or shrapnel) is visible ascending above the blast throughout.; A large ground-level explosion produces a rapidly expanding fireball and dense smoke plume, with debris and dust ejected outward; the blast evolves over time with multiple rising smoke columns and turbulent cloud formation.

A large, sustained ground-level explosion producing a massive plume of dark smoke and white/gray debris clouds that expand and rise over time; multiple distinct blast fronts visible across the frame, consistent with a high-yield detonation or secondary explosions.
